short_description: Warts are small skin growths often caused by a viral infection of the skin. They are usually harmless but can spread to other areas or other people.
common_symptoms: may appear on hands, feet, or body
temporary_advice: Keep the area clean and dry
Do not share towels or personal items
Cover the wart if it is likely to spread
Consider medical advice for safe removal options
avoid: Do not cut or pick the wart
Avoid sharing towels, razors, or nail tools
Do not try unsafe home removal methods
Avoid touching other skin areas after touching the wart
risk_notes: Warts are usually harmless, but they can spread and may need treatment if painful, multiple, or persistent.
when_to_see_doctor: If they become painful or bleed
If they are on the face, genitals, or sensitive areas
If you are unsure it is a wart
If they do not improve or keep returning
